previous_admission_summary.summary_paragraph: Mr. Thompson was admitted for his second maintenance cycle of high-dose methotrexate for primary central nervous system lymphoma. He had previously completed induction therapy and the first maintenance dose without complications. During this admission, he received high-dose methotrexate on day one, with leucovorin rescue initiated 24 hours later and continued until methotrexate levels dropped to 0.02, at which point it was discontinued. He developed mild, transient transaminitis and a drug-induced headache, both managed supportively. Constipation and cerumen impaction recurred but resolved with standard treatment. Aspirin and omeprazole were held during hospitalization and restarted at discharge. He was discharged home in stable condition with plans to continue outpatient chemotherapy as scheduled.

No new enhancing lesions are seen.

Linear susceptibility artifact is again seen in the posterior left frontal
lobe with the vertex, likely related to prior biopsy.  The ventricles are
